crossRefs.note: Hear, Yahweh, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.
Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
I called on your name, Yahweh, out of the lowest dungeon.
You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,
from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.
For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take…
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;
for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”
saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

translations.web: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
translations.bsb: Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
translations.kjv: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
translations.asv: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint: Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
